answer: Each new agent identity must emit a verifiable shale of sequential challenge-response traces that form an oasis of unique prior attestations, then freeze into an immutable willow of chained epoch records. Creating 1000 fakes forces an attacker to generate 1000 independent shales, each needing at least 50 sequential proofs that cannot be parallelized without quadratic verification cost, so marginal cost scales to thousands of compute-hours per fake cohort. An honest agent pays only ~10 minutes for one shale; fails if willow checkpoint rewrites without majority attestations
